steps.title: Analyze Codebase for Startup Crashes
steps.description: Analyze MainActivity and activity_main layout structure to detect potential runtime casting and UI thread crashes.

steps.title: Refactor LayoutParams in Chat Generation
steps.description: Replace generic ViewGroup.LayoutParams with explicit LinearLayout.LayoutParams inside appendChatBubble to prevent layout pass exceptions.

steps.title: Reconstruct dpToPx Conversion Method
steps.description: Redesign the dpToPx layout helper inside FileAdapter to accept an integer value to eliminate zero-multiplier sizing issues.

steps.title: Implement RadioGroup Wrapper in Settings
steps.description: Add a structured RadioGroup around active engine RadioButtons to resolve multiple-checked state conflicts.

steps.title: Clean Dependencies in Gradle Config
steps.description: Remove the unused NanoHTTPD external dependency to keep the build fully native and comply with local compilation restrictions.

steps.title: Verify Context Bindings
steps.description: Verify context referencing in adapter and UI initialization methods to guarantee correct thread dispatching.

steps.title: Review Layout Namespace Safety
steps.description: Inspect XML namespace values and ensure correct XML format for UI controls.

steps.title: Test Local Sandbox Persistence
steps.description: Verify that local app preferences and directory files populate without throwing startup exceptions.

steps.title: Validate Launch Manifest Alignment
steps.description: Verify that the AndroidManifest namespace and main launcher filter align correctly with the build parameters.

steps.title: Building AI File Companion
steps.description: Compile the fixed application with Gradle to confirm the crash is fully resolved and the build completes successfully.
